D: Two people who can't stand each other pretend to be a couple at a destination wedding in Sydney.
P: Serve the snacks when the wedding party heads out on the harbour.
S: Huntsman in the pants harbour prawns
Chilled cooked prawns on ice with lemon and spicy cocktail sauce

Cooked king prawns piled on ice with lemon wedges and a seafood sauce of mayo, tomato sauce and a dash of hot sauce. Pile crushed ice onto a platter and arrange 500g cooked prawns on top with lemon wedges. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tbsp tomato sauce and a dash of hot sauce. Serve in a bowl beside the prawns for a Sydney Harbour wedding.
Mini beef mince pies with puff lids, served with tomato sauce
Mini beef pies of mince and gravy in shortcrust with puff lids, baked at 200C for 20 minutes, with tomato sauce.
Opera House oysters with eschalot dressing
freshly shucked rock ones on crushed ice, sharp red wine vinegar, cracked pepper and lemon

Freshly shucked Sydney rock oysters on crushed ice with a sharp red wine vinegar and eschalot dressing, cracked pepper and lemon wedges. Finely dice 2 eschalots and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar, a pinch of sugar and plenty of cracked black pepper. Leave 15 minutes. Pile crushed ice onto a large platter. Check 24 freshly shucked oysters for shell grit and loosen each from its shell. Sit them on the ice with the dressing in a small bowl and a teaspoon, plus 2 lemons cut into wedges. Serve straight away.
M: Rosemary lamb cutlets with potato salad
frenched chops in garlic and lemon, grilled pink, warm potatoes with mustard and capers

Frenched lamb cutlets marinated in garlic, rosemary and lemon, grilled pink over high heat, with a warm potato salad of mustard, capers and herbs. Marinate 12 lamb cutlets in 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary and lemon zest for 30 minutes. Boil 1kg halved chat potatoes 15 minutes until tender. Whisk 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 2 tsp wholegrain mustard and 1 tbsp capers. Toss through the warm potatoes with parsley and sliced spring onion. Grill the cutlets on a very hot barbecue 2 to 3 minutes a side, rest 3 minutes and serve with lemon.
Crisp-skinned barramundi, crushed baby potatoes, lemon caper butter
Barramundi fillets pan-fried skin side down until crisp, with lemon butter and capers, and crushed potatoes.
W: Crisp meringue shell, whipped cream and fresh passionfruit

Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven, topped with whipped cream, passionfruit, kiwifruit and strawberries. Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Shape into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with whipped cream, passionfruit, kiwifruit and strawberries.
K: Sparkling wine, passionfruit pulp and elderflower

Fresh passionfruit pulp and a splash of elderflower cordial in chilled flutes, topped with cold Australian sparkling wine and a sprig of mint. Chill 4 flutes and a bottle of Australian sparkling wine. Scoop the pulp from 4 passionfruit and spoon 1 tbsp into each glass with 15ml elderflower cordial. Top slowly with about 120ml sparkling wine, stirring once to lift the pulp. Finish with a small sprig of mint. For non-drinkers, use sparkling apple juice or soda water instead of the wine.
